reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Aloe Soothing Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: It really smells like aloe and it hydrated my face a lot. I could notice a different. Even if it smells a lote like aloe it is not that strong and there was not smell of alcohol
reviews.zh: 真係好有蘆薈味，塊面保濕好多。我感覺到有分別。雖然好有蘆薈味但唔算好重，亦冇酒精味。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Aloe Soothing Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text:
The mask is super moisturising, especially when using retinol and AHA, BHA acids 
It's not sticky AT ALL and very thin
Extra pros: texture, thinnes
Cons: a little bit hard to open the mask itself since it does not have a plastic sheet inside the bag (which is not bad, we love the environment)
reviews.zh: 面膜超級保濕，尤其配合 retinol 同 AHA、BHA 酸性成分一齊用。完全唔黏笠，而且好薄。額外優點：質地、薄度。缺點：因為入面冇膠片托住，所以有少少難打開（不過呢點唔算壞事，大家都鍾意環保）。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Aloe Soothing Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: I like that the sheet mask holds a lot of product and barely any was left over in the package. There is a mild fragrance. Feels nice
reviews.zh: 鍾意呢款面膜可以承載好多精華，包入面幾乎冇剩。有淡淡香味，感覺好好。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Aloe Soothing Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: My skin is combination, but my T-zone gets very oily. The essence amount was just right, not too much. My skin didn’t feel sticky, and I didn’t feel the need to wash my face right after. The next day my skin looked more even
reviews.zh: 我係混合性肌，但 T 字位好容易出油。精華份量剛剛好，唔會太多。皮膚唔覺得黏笠，亦唔覺得需要即刻洗面。第二日皮膚望落均勻咗。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Aloe Soothing Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: My skin did not like this. It tingled and broke me out. Obviously didn't soothe and made my redness worse. Did stay on super well though
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚唔受呢款。有刺痛感，仲爆咗瘡。完全唔舒緩，仲令泛紅更加嚴重。不過貼面度真係一流。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Aloe Soothing Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: SOME BY MI is my forever go-to for sheet face masks because they never disappoint. As someone with sensitive skin, my face tends to react a lot to different face masks; but it's never reacted to this brand's products, but always leaving feeling refreshed, dewy, and glowing.
reviews.zh: SOME BY MI 係我永遠嘅片裝面膜首選，因為佢哋從未令我失望。我係敏感肌，好多唔同嘅面膜都會令我塊面有反應；但係呢個品牌嘅產品從未引起過我嘅反應，每次用完都總係感覺清爽、水光、又有光澤。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Aloe Soothing Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Купила эту маску по скидке. Качество среднее ,вцелом неплохо . Мне не понравился запах, но он быстро исчезает . Скажем так неплохо, скорее питает кожу чем увлажняет, больше чем за $ покупать не стоит
reviews.zh: 特價買咗呢塊面膜。質素一般，整體嚟講唔錯。我唔鍾意個味道，不過好快就散。咁講啦，唔算差，相比保濕更加似係滋養皮膚，唔值得用超過 $ 嘅價錢去買。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Aloe Soothing Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text:
This Real Aloe mask is a must-have in my routine, especially during hot weather or after a long day in the sun. It instantly soothes irritation, calms redness, and leaves the skin feeling fresh, hydrated, and super soft.

I keep it in the fridge for an extra cooling effect, and it’s a lifesaver after beach days or when my skin feels tired and sensitive. The aloe essence absorbs well and doesn’t leave any sticky residue.

It’s gentle, vegan, and biodegradable — I honestly can’t ask for more. I always keep a few of these on hand for skin emergencies or post-exfoliation recovery.
reviews.zh:
呢塊 Real Aloe 面膜係我護膚步驟入面必備嘅嘢，尤其喺天氣熱或者喺太陽底下曝咗一整日之後。用完即刻舒緩刺激、減退泛紅，皮膚感覺清爽、保濕、仲好柔軟。

我會將佢擺喺雪櫃入面，等佢涼浸浸效果更加好，去完沙灘或者皮膚覺得攰、敏感嘅時候真係救星。蘆薈精華吸收得好，唔會留低任何黏笠嘅殘留物。

佢好溫和，係純素而且可生物降解——講真我冇辦法要求更多。我成日都會 keep 定幾塊喺屋企，皮膚出狀況或者做完去角質之後用。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
